description: Search civil-society climate and energy research documents in the Climate Insights Directory. Accepted field operators in query: cidid, intitle, ispublisher, insummary, doctype, hasconcept, geography, lang. Accepted tool arguments: query, page, page_size, response_format, sort, organization, published_from, published_to, added, climate_tags, geography, geography_discussed, frame_perspective, analysis_type, document_type, language.

added.description: Filter by corpus ingestion date, UTC: one day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an inclusive day range (YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD), both days included, the first not after the last.

analysis_type.description: Filter by analysis type (repeatable vocabulary facet).

climate_tags.description: Filter by climate tags (repeatable vocabulary facet).

document_type.description: Filter by document type (repeatable vocabulary facet).

frame_perspective.description: Filter by frame or perspective (repeatable vocabulary facet).

geography.description: Filter by primary geography (repeatable vocabulary facet).

geography_discussed.description: Filter by regions discussed (repeatable vocabulary facet).

language.description: Filter by ISO language code (repeatable vocabulary facet).

organization.description: Filter by publishing organization slug (e.g. south-african-institute-of-international-affairs) or organization identifier (e.g. saiia).

query.description: Search query string with optional field operators. Required.

response_format.description: Response detail level: concise or detailed

sort.description: Sort ordering: relevance, published, or published_asc.

name: search
title: Search documents in Climate Insights Directory
